documents.title: Formulary notice
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Mail-order pharmacy notice: olodaterol (Striverdi) moved to a higher tier on his 2026 Part D plan; copay up. Plan lists no step requirement, no PA needed. Called pt - he wants to stay on it and will pay the copay. Renewed x 1 yr per PCP along with the other chronic meds.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Rooming Note
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Vitals obtained. Med list reviewed, pharmacy confirmed (mail-order). Current smoker. Pt asked for printed after-visit summary.

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
F/u HTN/HHD, CAD, COPD, PAD, AAA.

Got through the winter without a chest infection this year. Breathing at baseline - stairs one flight with a rest. Cough mornings. Same exertional chest tightness, no rest symptoms.
Smoking: tried stopping after New Year's, lasted 4 days. Back to 1 ppd. Willing to try again 'when it's warmer.'
Using olodaterol 'most days.'

Vitals: BP 151/97, HR 66, SpO2 94% RA, wt 92.7.
Exam: barrel chest, diminished BS, prolonged exp. Heart regular, PMI lateral. No edema.

A/P
1. HTN/HHD - 151/97. Continue lisinopril 20, HCTZ 25, metoprolol succ 50.
2. COPD - olodaterol. Pulm yearly f/u, he says they booked him for September.
3. CAD - stable.
4. AAA 4.6 cm - vascular rescan June.
5. Tobacco - a real attempt; praised. Readdress next visit.

RTC 3 mo with labs.

documents.title: question
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Does the shingles shot I had cover me for good or do I need another one

documents.title: RE: question
documents.author: RN
documents.body: You completed the 2-dose Shingrix series (October 2022 and January 2023). No booster is recommended at this time.

documents.body: Roomed. Vitals x1. Reviewed allergies (NKDA) and meds. Smoking daily, about a pack.

documents.title: Office Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
F/u.

Breathing same as spring. No infections. Chest tightness on hills unchanged. Calves at two blocks. No new symptoms.
Smoking 1 ppd, hasn't tried again. Vascular surgery scan - he has a letter saying they will call to schedule.
Meds: all, olodaterol on most days.

Vitals: BP 150/90, HR 75, SpO2 92% RA.
Exam: diminished BS, prolonged exp. Heart regular. Abd soft, pulsatile mass. No edema.

A/P
- HTN/HHD: 150/90. Same meds.
- CAD/HLD: BMP, lipids, CBC today.
- COPD: olodaterol; pulm in September.
- AAA: vascular surgery to schedule.
- Tobacco: counseled.

RTC 3 mo. AWV due after late August.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Lyle - your labs from Tuesday: kidney function and potassium normal (creatinine 0.94, potassium 4.2), blood count normal, LDL 77 on atorvastatin. No changes.

documents.author: patient
documents.body: Mail order says the striverdi is on hold, needs the doctor to ok it. Can you call them. Lyle

documents.body: Called the mail-order pharmacy - the hold was a quantity check (refill requested sooner than expected). PCP confirmed the prescription; it ships this week. Your next appointment is September 22.
